title: A mall world dream that just felt...wrong
content: I just remembered a mall world dream that I had when I was really young (This was even before that one dream I had about the shopping mall with the moving walkway and dark room with a light show). I'm in what looks like a grimy 'ole basement (During this time I lived in a house with a basement that had sports car-themed wallpaper). I come across a rather ancient photo that supposedly showed a Chinese family (In my waking life my family were all Chinese immigrants). The father in the photo was looking absolutely horrified, his mouth open in a silent scream while everybody else looked happy as clams. The photo was eerie, certainly, but I woke back up in the real world before I could start finding out what got the father so terrified. Is that kind of dream supposed to mean something? Happy Thanksgiving, guys!
